findings.quoted_finding: The central current lifecycle snapshot still pins the round-1 AC commit, manifest, DAG and ledger, so its own versioned checker output is stale and no longer reproducible.
defect_evidence: The current JSON pins round-1 manifest 6ba078ef, DAG bd440d, ledger f753140 and packaged commit 886c440.
The current round-2 bytes are manifest fc9788a, DAG 830aede, ledger 280f816 and packaged commit 7248c56.
Reexecuting the versioned lifecycle checker returns 80 PASS and 2 FAIL, while the stored output says 82 PASS and 0 FAIL.
findings.reasoning: A file named current must reproduce the current pinned snapshot. The mismatch is real but administrative and conservative; it leaves the governed mathematical candidate and downstream authorization boundary intact.
findings.disposition: Repin only the four central lifecycle artifacts to the round-2 commit, manifest, DAG and ledger; rerun the lifecycle checker; do not change any mathematical candidate blob or downstream flag.

reasons: The round-2 mathematical candidate and closure of AC-R1-MIN-1 are clean.
The central lifecycle checker independently reproduces two exact stale-hash failures.
The repair is administrative, uniquely bounded and safe; no material issue remains unresolved.
